recipes.title: Carved by water
recipes.description: An oversized moving title meets the scale of Yosemite Falls.
recipes.prompt: Make an 8-second landscape film using waterfall footage. Use oversized amber typography reading “Carved by water”, a restrained cinematic grade, and natural ambient sound. Keep the title, footage, and sound independently editable. Use my footage if I supply it; otherwise help me find suitable licensed footage.

recipes.title: Yosemite Peregrines
recipes.description: A Yosemite ranger's awe lands with one restrained editorial title and word-timed captions.
recipes.transcriptExcerpt: It’s just phenomenal how unbelievably fast they are when they’re in that perfect tuck or stoop, as biologists call it, in the dive.
recipes.prompt: Turn a strong 10-second talking-head quote into a cinematic landscape edit. Keep the speaker and any source lower-third fully visible, place one restrained title behind the subject, add accurate word-timed captions above the bottom safe area, preserve the original voice, and use my brand kit for the logo and caption accents.
